basic_info.description: This property is a court-ordered sale subject to court confirmation. Perched in the desirable Glen Park neighborhood, this 4-bedroom, 2-bathroom home boasts south-facing panoramic views. The main level features a kitchen, living room, and bath, all bedrooms are located on the upper level. Major potential for expansion within the existing structure, this property offers a unique opportunity to re-create a magnificent home. The garage and basement provide generous space and ceiling height for additional possibilities. The property is being offered for sale with tenants in place and subject to that tenancy. Do not disturb tenants.
